requirements.title: Player Controller
requirements.remaining: Physics movement, screen-relative steering, joystick deadzone/size, cancellation and focus handling are implemented. Physical-device handling and human responsiveness review remain.

requirements.title: Primary Controls
requirements.remaining: Joystick, cardinal buttons and optional arena swipes are implemented. Tap/swipe/cancel separation is checked with native Chromium touch injection; WebKit gesture and physical-device ergonomics require manual validation.

requirements.title: Gravity System Architecture
requirements.remaining: One spatially indexed authority combines global and local vector fields, falloff, material/tag filters and response scaling. Gameplay systems use the shared authority.

requirements.title: Gravity Modes
requirements.remaining: Cardinal, rotating, radial, repulsive, orbital, zero, inverted, well, vortex, traveling-wave and lock modes are implemented. Gravity Chain circulates signed response through up to five eligible targets; Transfer exchanges a pair's gravity and momentum. Independent generation-bound factors expire without erasing phase/theft/parasite effects. Static or suppressed bodies no longer acquire flip/rotation ownership.

requirements.remaining: 128 challenges including per-power mastery milestones. Rewards include currency/research, equipment, six core appearances, eight titles and six memories. Reward idempotency, unlock restrictions, selection and migration are tested. Balance remains a separate review.

requirements.title: Mastery System
requirements.remaining: Every catalog power plus well/flip has five mastery milestones based on casts, causal kills, elites, chain size and a victory contribution. New powers derive objectives automatically; human grind/balance review remains separate.

requirements.title: Endless Mode
requirements.remaining: Endless wraps the region catalog and derives persistent stage pressure from rooms completed. Milestones 10/20/30/40/50/100/200/500 add rifts, rotation, reversal, zero zones, singularities, planets, storms and reality instability. Stage 500 moves geometry and pulses on impact; fields/bodies remain capped. Depth health pressure continues beyond the old cap of 12. Tests cover checkpoint recovery, pooled bodies, dead planets, stress and three browser layouts. Human high-stage balance remains external.

requirements.title: Infinite Build Scaling
requirements.remaining: Endless rule escalation, finite stat limits, bounded chains/fields/velocity and crowd-control resistance implemented. Further run/balance stress validation remains.

requirements.title: Difficulty System

requirements.title: Camera
requirements.remaining: Top-down camera frames the whole room on desktop and follows the core on narrow/short views; telegraphs, trails, fields and physical silhouettes remain in world coordinates. Human readability on devices remains part of the device gate.

requirements.title: Visual Direction
requirements.remaining: Directional chevrons, signed field symbols, expanding pulse rings, curved field particles, motion trails, bounded impact deformation and background lensing are implemented. Void fields have a dark core and bright orbit ring. Lensing selects at most six sources; field motes cap at 64; low-power/reduced-motion disable grid distortion. Browser captures were reviewed. Human instant-readability and physical-device motion/performance review remain open.

requirements.title: Gravity Visual Language
requirements.remaining: Directional chevrons, signed field symbols, expanding pulse rings, curved field particles, motion trails, bounded impact deformation and background lensing are implemented. requirements.title: Animation
requirements.remaining: Velocity stretch, impact-normal deformation, gravity-flip/power pulses, physical spin/bounce/orbit, damage labels, shield outlines, telegraphs and death/explosion particles cover core motion states. These do not change collider geometry; reduced-motion/flashing settings suppress applicable effects. Human animation quality remains a separate review.

requirements.title: Juice System
requirements.remaining: Central typed-event feedback coordinates bounded particles, labels, rings, trails, deformation, sound, shake, haptics and rate-limited 32 ms hit pause. Reduced motion disables hit pause and deformation.

requirements.title: Chain Reaction System
requirements.remaining: Causal IDs propagate across manipulated bodies, impacts, explosions and material reactions; chains deduplicate effects and cap depth, lifetime and effect counts. HUD/feedback show current chains and run summaries retain the best.

requirements.title: Run Events
requirements.remaining: Ten encounters include merchants, experiments, run-long gravity changes, resource sacrifices, wreckage exploration and optional combat trials. Combat rewards require victory, preserve the original route node, and cannot be claimed twice. Dense/Light mutations alter actual core mass and acceleration. Checkpoint snapshots are detached from live state; combat recovery returns to the preceding unclaimed event. Human risk/reward balance remains open.

requirements.title: Ghost System
requirements.remaining: Successful unassisted runs record bounded quarter-second positional traces per chamber. Matching seed/rules/starting bonuses/revision replay a visual-only ghost with interpolation; imports share routes. Resumed or truncated runs retain results only. One complete ghost and 20 results persist locally, including native storage.
